Name: Milktosis - Craft milk from large milk
Author: Imbion
Description:
For when you don't need a massive jug of milk for that omelette you're making. Because that would be wasteful.

[u][b]Requirements:
[/b][/u][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/240]SMAPI[/url] & [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher [/url]

[u][b]What it does:[/b][/u]
Adds a configurable crafting recipe that unlocks at Farming level 4, which allows you to craft large milk into more regular milk. Works for goat milk as well.

[b][u]Config Options:
[/u][/b]- Can individually select different balance modes for Goat Milk and Cow Milk.
- Recipe Variants:
﻿- [b]Divide: [/b]Convert one large milk into two milk.
﻿- [b]Hardwood: [/b]Conversion recipe also costs two hardwood. (Default)
﻿- [b]Refined Quartz: [/b]Conversion recipe also costs one refined quartz.
﻿- [b]Price Neutral[/b]: Convert two large milk into three milks.
﻿- [b]Disabled:[/b] Add no crafting recipe.

Manifest.Name: Milktosis
Manifest.Description: Adds configurable crafting recipies to divide large milk into regular milk.
